name: 4-MeS-DMT
summary: 4-MeS-DMT, or 4-SMe-DMT, also known as 4-methylthio-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and possible psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to psilocin. It is the 4-methylthio derivative of psilocin (4-HO-DMT) and is an analogue of 4-MeO-DMT. The drug's properties and effects in humans are unknown. It shows affinity for serotonin receptors.

pharmacology.text: 4-MeS-DMT, or 4-SMe-DMT, also known as 4-methylthio-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and possible psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to psilocin. It shows affinity for serotonin receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

summaryZh: 4-MeS-DMT是一種含氮有機硫化合物，化學式C13H18N2S，和其類似物5-MeS-DMT、4-MeO-DMT、5-MeO-DMT一樣能作為致幻劑，由亞歷山大·舒爾金首次合成。
summaryZhHans: 4-MeS-DMT是一种含氮有机硫化合物，化学式C13H18N2S，和其类似物5-MeS-DMT、4-MeO-DMT、5-MeO-DMT一样能作为致幻剂，由亚历山大·舒尔金首次合成。

uses.en: It is known only from laboratory studies of serotonin receptors. Its effects in people are unknown.
uses.zh: 它只出現在血清素受體的實驗室研究中，在人體的作用不明。
uses.zhHans: 它只出现在血清素受体的实验室研究中，在人体的作用不明。

fact.en: It is psilocin with the oxygen at the 4 position swapped for sulphur, which sits directly below oxygen in the periodic table.
fact.zh: 它相當於把脫磷酸裸蓋菇素第4位上的氧換成硫；在週期表上，硫就在氧的正下方。
fact.zhHans: 它相当于把脱磷酸裸盖菇素第4位上的氧换成硫；在周期表上，硫就在氧的正下方。
